title: Quick Melted Portuguese Cheese Quesadilla
description: A kid-friendly Portuguese dish featuring shredded monterey jack cheese, with a citrusy and gooey texture, made with brine-wet and vegetarian-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a quick snack or lunch.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Brush one side of each tortilla with the lemon juice mixture.
Place one tortilla, brushed side down, in the preheated skillet.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is lightly browned and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also lightly browned.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and cheese.
Cut into wedges and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
